title: Cytotoxic Evaluation and Molecular Docking Studies of Aminopyridine Derivatives as Potential Anticancer Agents.
authors: Ilyas, Umair; Alkury, Lina Tariq; Naaz, Shagufta; Muhammad, Syed Aun; Nadeem, Humaira; Altaf, Reem; Zaman, Shahiq Uz; Faheem, Muhammad; Sajid, Imran; Cheema, Mohsin Tasawar; Mannan, Abdul; Shah, Fawad Ali; Li, Shupeng
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估氨基吡啶衍生物的抗癌活性，涉及小分子与β-catenin蛋白的分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The development of resistance to available anticancer drugs is increasingly becoming a major challenge and new chemical entities could be unveiled to compensate for this therapeutic failure. OBJECTIVES: The current study demonstrated whether N-protected and deprotected amino acid derivatives of 2- aminopyridine could attenuate tumor development using colorectal cancer cell lines. METHODS: Biological assays were performed to investigate the anticancer potential of synthesized compounds. The in silico ADME profiling and docking studies were also performed by docking the designed compounds against the active binding site of beta-catenin (CTNNB1) to analyze the binding mode of these compounds. Four derivatives 4a, 4b, 4c, and 4d were selected for investigation of in vitro anticancer potential using colorectal cancer cell line HCT 116. The anti-tumor activities of synthesized compounds were further validated by evaluating the inhibitory effects of these compounds on the target protein beta-catenin through in vitro enzyme inhibitory assay. RESULTS: The docking analysis revealed favorable binding energies and interactions with the target proteins. The in vitro MTT assay on colorectal cancer cell line HCT 116 and HT29 revealed potential anti-tumor activities with an IC50 range of 3.7-8.1muM and 3.27-7.7 muM, respectively. The inhibitory properties of these compounds on the concentration of beta-catenin by ELISA revealed significant percent inhibition of target protein at 100 mug/ml. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, the synthesized compounds showed significant anti-tumor activities both in silico and in vitro, having potential for further investigating its role in colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：对现有抗癌药物耐药性的发展日益成为重大挑战，新的化学实体可能被揭示以弥补这一治疗失败。目的：本研究探讨了N-保护及去保护的2-氨基吡啶氨基酸衍生物是否能通过结直肠癌细胞系减弱肿瘤发展。方法：进行了生物学测定以研究合成化合物的抗癌潜力。同时，通过将设计化合物对接至β-连环蛋白（CTNNB1）的活性结合位点，进行了计算机模拟ADME分析和对接研究，以分析这些化合物的结合模式。选取了四种衍生物4a、4b、4c和4d，使用结直肠癌细胞系HCT 116研究其体外抗癌潜力。通过体外酶抑制试验评估这些化合物对靶蛋白β-连环蛋白的抑制效果，进一步验证了合成化合物的抗肿瘤活性。结果：对接分析显示与靶蛋白具有良好的结合能和相互作用。对结直肠癌细胞系HCT 116和HT29的体外MTT试验揭示了潜在的抗肿瘤活性，IC50范围分别为3.7-8.1μM和3.27-7.7μM。通过ELISA检测这些化合物对β-连环蛋白浓度的抑制特性，在100 μg/ml浓度下显示出对靶蛋白的显著抑制百分比。结论：总之，合成化合物在计算机模拟和体外均显示出显著的抗肿瘤活性，具有进一步研究其在结直肠癌中作用的潜力。
